milestones.title: A Role for Your Slot
milestones.joke: The platform vouches for the app.

milestones.title: Deployed With Identity
milestones.when: bao: a `jwt-platform` login that got `app-read` (the app's own identity from the platform)

milestones.title: The Pipeline Cannot Read
milestones.joke: Deployed, but never saw the secret.
milestones.when: verify: the pipeline's `jwt-ci` role `ci-main` has no read on `team/data/app` (checked after the platform deploy)

milestones.title: Rotated, No Deploy
milestones.when: shell: `bao kv put` or `patch` on `team/app` (exit 0) after the platform role was written
